clocks.v8: process.hrtime.bigint around bench plus scalar status assertion; module instantiate and main excluded
clocks.native: CLOCK_MONOTONIC around bench only; host/module initialization, main, printing, native_finish excluded
clocks.chez: unchanged run-r7rs-benchmark loop and predicate with monotonic nanosecond jiffies; reading/compilation/startup/output excluded
clocks.process: parent perf_counter around spawn, pipe capture, reap and owned-group cleanup; secondary duration only

plan.comparison_scope: Production V8 versus original/adapted Chez; common-artifact V8 versus mechanical native; production/common V8 separates repeated Binaryen effects.
plan.native_resource_limit: Default 256 MiB arena exhausted canonical input; same body passes with explicit 1 GiB reservation. No GC stats or profiler during clean runs.
